$schema_note: Historical curtailment decisions, replayed against the engine.
EVERY case carries the sentence it was read from. That is not decoration.
A figure of 39.3 cfs, which appears nowhere in Shasta Addendum 6, propagated
out of a research haul into the build constitution, two test files, the corpus
manifest and a public README, and survived a dedicated verification pass and a
passing test suite. Only opening the PDF caught it. A case whose reading came
from a summary rather than from the document is not evidence of anything.
A case is admitted only when the document states BOTH a point reading and the
date that reading was taken. Documents that state a bound ('at or above 60
cfs') or a reference table rather than a reading are excluded and listed under
excluded_with_reason, because scoring a bound as though it were a measurement
would be inventing precision the Board did not publish.

regulatory_era.description: 23 CCR 875 to 875.9 as readopted effective January 27, 2025 and extended by AB 263.
empirical_confirmation: Every monthly minimum stated in a 2024-era addendum matches the encoded schedule:
Scott September 33 cfs (Addendum 3), Scott October 40 cfs (Addendum 5),
Shasta October 105 cfs (Addendum 2), Shasta October 105 and November 125 cfs
So for every month in evidence the 2024 and 2025 tables agree. This is measured
why_bounded: The 2021 cycle is a separate adoption whose flow table has NOT been verified
in full against a primary source. Scoring a 2021 decision against the
readopted schedule risks marking the Board wrong for correctly applying the
Measured 2026-08-10 across 60 fetched 2021-era documents: every Scott month
those documents state MATCHES the readopted table (Jan 200, Feb 200, Mar 200,

An earlier draft asserted the 2021 cycle used a 135 cfs sustained suspension
threshold. That figure appears in NONE of the 60 documents. It came from a
research summary, the same path the retired 39.3 cfs reading took, and it is
no longer asserted anywhere in this repository.

excluded_with_reason.reason: States a bound, not a reading: flows 'have been at or above the September flow requirement (60 cfs)'. Scoring a bound as a measurement would invent precision the Board did not publish.
excluded_with_reason.separate_finding: This document, dated November 13 2024, calls 60 cfs 'the September flow requirement'. Under 23 CCR 875 the Scott September minimum is 33 cfs and 60 cfs is NOVEMBER's figure. Scott Addendum 3 states September as 33 cfs in the same series, so two addenda in one series disagree about September. The number matches the month the addendum was issued in, not the month it names.

excluded_with_reason.reason: No sentence in the document states a point reading with its date. The constitution carries '145 versus the 150 May minimum', but that figure was not confirmed against this document, and a case sourced from a summary is not evidence.
Same as Addendum 9. The trigger reading is not yet verified from the document itself.
